select DISTINCT a.tenant_id, a.industry_code, a.APP_VER_CODE, a.dept_id, a.provinceCode, a.cityCode, a.countyCode, a.streetAreaCode from( SELECT t1.tenant_id, t1.industry_code, t1.APP_VER_CODE, t1.dept_id, t2.province_id as provinceCode, t2.city_id as cityCode, t2.county_id as countyCode, t2.town_code as streetAreaCode FROM vm_organ_device_rel_t t1 LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t t2 ON t1.device_code = t2.device_code where t1.delete_flag = '0' and t2.delete_flag = '0' and t1.device_type = '4'
UNION ALL SELECT t1.tenant_id, t1.industry_code, t1.APP_VER_CODE, t1.dept_id, t2.province_id as provinceCode, t2.city_id as cityCode, t2.county_id as countyCode, t2.town_code as streetAreaCode FROM vm_organ_device_rel_t t1 LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t t2 ON t1.device_code = t2.device_code where t1.delete_flag = '0' and t2.delete_flag = '0' and t1.device_type = '8' and t2.category_code= 2
UNION ALL SELECT t1.tenant_id, t1.industry_code, t1.APP_VER_CODE, t1.dept_id, t2.province_id as provinceCode, t2.city_id as cityCode, t2.county_id as countyCode, t2.town_code as streetAreaCode FROM vm_organ_device_rel_t t1 LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t t2 ON t1.device_code = t2.device_code where t1.delete_flag = '0' and t2.delete_flag = '0' and t1.device_type = '10' and t2.category_code= 1
UNION ALL SELECT t1.tenant_id, t1.industry_code, t1.APP_VER_CODE, t1.dept_id, t2.province_code as provinceCode, t2.city_code as cityCode, t2.county_code as countyCode, t2.town_code as streetAreaCode FROM vm_organ_device_rel_t t1 LEFT JOIN vm_uav_device_info_t t2 ON t1.device_code = t2.device_code where t1.delete_flag = '0' and t2.delete_flag = '0' and t1.device_type = '11'
UNION ALL SELECT t1.tenant_id, t1.industry_code, t1.APP_VER_CODE, t1.dept_id, t2.province_code as provinceCode, t2.city_code as cityCode, t2.county_code as countyCode, t2.town_code as streetAreaCode FROM vm_organ_device_rel_t t1 LEFT JOIN vm_horn_device_info_t t2 ON t1.device_code = t2.device_code where t1.delete_flag = '0' and t2.delete_flag = '0' and t1.device_type = '12'
